psychological_meaning: Eucalyptus evokes feelings of freshness, healing, and tranquility. It is associated with nature, cleanliness, and rejuvenation, promoting a sense of well-being and mental clarity. This color can also symbolize resilience and adaptability, reflecting the hardy nature of the eucalyptus tree.
